In this review, we'll delve into the core mechanics of the game, exploring what makes it so addictive and visually stunning. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a fun and relaxing experience, Space Tower has something to offer. So, let's get started and see if this game can reach new heights!

The game features a variety of levels, each with its own unique challenges and obstacles. As players progress, the cubes become larger and more frequent, requiring even greater precision and timing to navigate.

The game's visuals are truly breathtaking, with a stunning starry night sky and beautifully designed space cubes.
